about_the_game:
Please Note:

Communication between players is crucial for this game. While we Highly recommend an environment where players can communicate via voice chat, please be aware that the game does not include a built-in voice chat feature. Please keep this in mind before purchasing.

Your friendship will be tested by A whirlwind of "cooperation" and "crazy happenings"...
A high-difficulty, two-player parking game where communication is key!

◆Have a blast with friends in chaotic "high-difficulty parking"!

Your one and only goal: park the car at its destination!

But be warned. This is not an ordinary parking...!

  • One wrong move, and BOOM!

One hit and you're out! Communicate and give directions to survive the nail-biting tension!

  • You age outside the car?!

Step outside, and you'll begin to age rapidly! (And in the end...)

Your time outside is limited, so you'll need to skillfully swap drivers to proceed!

◆ Add to your Wishlist now!

*We welcome individuals to create and share gameplay content, including live streams and videos, of this game.Monetization through partner programs or creator programs on platforms like YouTube and Twitch is also permitted. However, for commercial use by corporate entities, please contact us directly.

*This game uses AI generation tools to create some of its graphical assets. All assets have been supervised and modified by the development team to fit the game's world and aesthetic.

name: Parking Together!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8/8.1/10 x86 and x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6750 (2 * 2660) or equivalent | AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 6000+ (2 * 3000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 740 (2048 MB) or equivalent | Radeon HD 5770 (1024 MB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: "Parking Together!" is a chaotic two-player "parking" game. Players must cooperate to park a car that will explode on the slightest impact. Grab a friend and challenge yourselves with this intense and hilarious gameplay now!
supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Korean
